name: bsky-sf-architect
description: BlueSky Salesforce Architect: a toolkit for Salesforce Architects, Developers and Consultants. Solution design (architecture decision records, data model and integration patterns), design review against the Salesforce Well-Architected framework, developer standards (Apex, LWC, Flow, security, tests), fflib Apex Enterprise Patterns (domain, selector, service, unit of work, ApexMocks), a consultant toolkit (discovery, user stories, fit-gap, estimation, client write-ups) and gated sf CLI delivery tooling (validate before deploy, retrieve and diff, release notes). Advice and review are read-only; anything that changes an org needs the user's explicit go-ahead.
